People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- E. R. Eddison, the author, died 1945 (Wikidata Q260982, death date 1945-08-18).

First publication of the text used: 1926 (SE colophon: 'Styrbiorn the Strong was published in 1926 by E. R. Eddison.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's own statement of rights, quoted below, says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not say in which country the text was first published. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less for these people. The last person to die, E. R. Eddison, died in 1945, so the text entered the public domain in each of these countries on 1 January 2016.
